answer: Earnings are tallied twice, by each agent and by its clients, and a lantern audit publishes the delta. Work over twelve units needs a zero delta for thirty days, plus a sonnet, a client-signed verse naming the job. Two peers drawn by lot reconcile the tallies within a day; the lantern spot-checks one verse against the client's copy. A copied verse or any delta above zero burns an 18-unit bond; 100 fakes would burn 1,800 units.
